messages:
IncidentBot: [P1] Spike detected: inference-runtime-prod exhibiting elevated error rate and queueing. Affected org: org_87342 (BlueHarbor). Platform 5xxs + p95 latency increased. Paging oncall.
Ravi (oncall): Oncall ack. Looking at dashboards and per-org telemetry. Mei, can you pull per-org QPS, streaming session counts, and KV cache miss rate for org_87342?
Mei - SRE: Pulling now. BlueHarbor started a large burst at 15:42 UTC. Their session count x20, streaming connections doubled, and we see KV cache churn up 3x. Per-org policy was 250 rps burst allowed; they're at ~2k rps sustained. Node queue depth for runtime workers spiked and token generation throttled.
Aaron - Runtime: That much KV churn explains elevated tail latency. For immediate protection we should cap their QPS at a safe level, or flip their traffic to a smaller model variant. Throttling first to minimize disruption.
Ravi (oncall): Throttle then. Use a short TTL and tag with incident id. Clara, loop in the customer and suggest pausing any replay jobs.
Clara - CS: Will message their engineering contact now. ETA for update to customer in ~2m.
Mei - SRE: Prepared admin API call to apply a temporary hard cap. Command below — setting qps to 120 and burst to 240, expires in 20m.

```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood/api/orgs/org_87342/controls/rate_limit" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"qps":120, "burst":240, "expiry":"20m", "note":"emergency-protect-1769510000"}'
```

Ravi (oncall): Execute and report.
Mei - SRE: Running now.
OpsBot: Rate limit change applied for org_87342 by mei.s 176: change_id=rl_20260315_A1, qps=120, burst=240, expiry=20m.
Mei - SRE: After change: org qps falling to ~100, platform queue depth dropping. Platform 5xxs reduced from 16% -> 4% in 5 minutes; p95 down from 1.9s -> 480ms.
Clara - CS: Customer replied: "We see errors on our end, investigating a replay job. Pausing now, will confirm." Forwarded confirmation.
Aaron - Runtime: Good signal. Let's keep the hard cap for now and observe for 30m. If customer confirms pause and metrics stable, we'll do phased restore: 120 -> 300 -> normal.
Ravi (oncall): Agreed. Mei, extend TTL to 60m so we don't flip too fast while they validate.
Mei - SRE: Extending change.

```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood/api/changes/rl_20260315_A1/extend" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"expiry":"60m","reason":"allow time for customer pause and safe rollback"}'
```

OpsBot: Change rl_20260315_A1 extended by mei.s 176: new_expiry=60m.
Mei - SRE: Noting audit: before_qps~=2100, after_qps=120, change_id=rl_20260315_A1. Saving command history.
Ravi (oncall): Action items: Clara confirm customer paused and coordinate restore window. Aaron capture runtime tuning suggestions (auto-downscale to small model on replay patterns). Mei collect logs + attach change to incident ticket.
Clara - CS: Customer confirms paused. Asking for a 30m observation period before staged restore. I'll coordinate and notify them before each step.
Aaron - Runtime: Recommend a post-incident automation: detect sustained per-org replay behavior (many retries + 4xx/429 pattern) and automatically apply conservative circuit-breaker for streaming endpoints.
Mei - SRE: I'll include that as remediation. For tonight: keep cap, monitor p95 and 5xx for 15m stable window, then staged restore.
Ravi (oncall): Make the incident notes. I'll escalate to Leah if we need longer remediation work. I'm marking mitigation successful so far.
IncidentBot: Incident updated: status=mitigated (traffic capped), mitigation=rate limit rl_20260315_A1.
OpsBot: Monitoring: platform 5xx=3.8%, p95=530ms, org_87342 qps=95. All trending to healthy.
Mei - SRE: Creating postmortem draft PM-2026-03-15-blueharbor-spike, assigning follow-ups to Aaron and product-security for retry guidance and per-org quota hardening.
Ravi (oncall): Handoff to Mei for post-incident follow-up. I'll remain reachable if escalation needed. Thanks team.
Clara - CS: Sending final customer note: "We applied a temporary cap to protect platform health. We'll coordinate a staged restore and provide guidance on retry/backoff best practices."
